_doc: Camera shots for tools/capture/capture.mjs. cam = [x, y, z, yaw, pitch] (y 1.6 = standing eye height, yaw/pitch in radians, yaw 0 looks toward -z). path = keyframes in the same form, played over `seconds` as a clip. optional shots only run when named. setup = JS run inside the game module before the shot. Find a pose in the game: open the browser console and run __cap.pose (needs the hook) or copy the camera from your shot. Add shots for what you are changing; keep existing names stable so before/after pairs line up.

vagrants.setup: if(!window.__lineup){ window.__lineup=1; const cols=[0xff6e9e,0x3fa8e8,0xf2c230,0x26d3a0,0x8f6bff,0xff8a3c,0xe07a2e]; const hats=[0xFF5D8F,0xF2C230,0x3FA8E8,0x26D3A0,0x8F6BFF], pants=[0x4D6FC9,0x5A4C80,0x6A6E7E,0x3E5A8A], hood=[0x9AA3B8,0x7A3E4E,0xD8C9A8,0x5E7A4A]; const sh=h=>{ const c=new THREE.Color(h); c.offsetHSL(0,0,-.12); return c.getHex(); }; for(let i=0;i<7;i++){ const look=typeof charLook==='function' ? charLook('lineup'+i,'#'+cols[i].toString(16).padStart(6,'0')) : {coat:cols[i],coatSh:sh(cols[i]),hat:hats[i%5],hatSh:sh(hats[i%5]),pants:pants[i%4],hoodie:hood[(i+1)%4],scarf:i%2?0xE8343F:0}; vagrant({x:1.2+i*1.15,z:-4.2,ry:i===6?-.35:(i%2?.25:-.25),...look,...(i===6?{sign:['ANYTHING','HELPS :)']}:{})}); } }
